openQuestions.text: Where do system-speckit templates carry reducible token weight, and which Reducer-Engineering techniques map to concrete cuts?
Which Agent-Engineering harness patterns already exist in the doc workflow / deep-loop, and which are genuine gaps for plan adherence?
What does the context/memory system already reduce, and what token-reduction gaps remain?
What is the ranked implementable shortlist and the refutation list?

resolvedQuestions.answer: Cross-variant core duplication (~35-40% of manifest weight); dedupe -> ungated core restructure with zero renderer change

resolvedQuestions.text: Which harness patterns exist vs gap?
resolvedQuestions.answer: All four exist: Default-FAIL=validate.sh --strict, fresh evaluator=deep-review+deterministic gates, handoff=_memory.continuity+handover.md, feature-at-a-time=plan phases
Already reduces: compact-merger pre-merge selection + envelope token budgets rendering overflow rows compact (never deleted, telemetried)

S1 ungated-core template restructure; S2 staleness+weight-budget extension; S3 core prose dedupe; S4 budget telemetry export. Refuted: LLM evaluator for docs (R1), new deep-loop reducer (R2), progress-file system (R3), checkpoint commits for docs (R4), more workers (R5)

keyFindings.summary: 4 gated variants each embed full L1 core; spec.md.tmpl L2/L3/L3+ = 72/60/53% exact dup; plan.md.tmpl = 73/58/49%; ungated-core restructure removes redundancy with zero renderer change
checklist/implementation-summary templates have lower per-level duplication; restructure only where measured high
staleness checker guards scaffold-vs-template only, not intra-template variant agreement; variant edits can silently diverge
copy_template + inline-gate-renderer IS the deterministic reducer for scaffolding; do not reinvent
Memory system implements reducer playbook: compact-merger pre-merge selection + envelope token-budget compaction with compact:true stamping and telemetry
All four Agent-Engineering harness patterns have in-repo equivalents (Default-FAIL, fresh evaluator, handoff memory, feature-at-a-time)
Duplication extends to all four templates: implementation-summary variants 95/95/99% dup, checklist 70/67% dup; ~40% of manifest lines are exact duplicates
No declared template weight budget and no intra-variant agreement check; staleness checker guards scaffold drift only
